turns.question: By what percentage was revenue on Thursday 24 September 2026 up on the same weekday a week earlier?
turns.answer: Revenue on Thursday 24 September 2026 was up 21.1% on Thursday 17 September 2026, the same weekday a week earlier (a growth share of 0.21, from the revenue week-over-week growth metric for that day).
